name: redo_document
description: Re-apply the state undone by the last revert_document (pops the per-session redo stack, restores it, commits as new head). Success carries advisory changedValues [{nodeId,before,after}] (pre-redo live text -> restored text, same bounds as save/preview). Empty stack fails with E_NOT_FOUND plus atLatestState:true (a fresh execute_batch edit clears redo, and each redo consumes one entry). Optional author (<=100 chars, default ASTra Agent) + reason (<=500 chars, preferred over message) with the same hygiene as save/revert. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {ok:true,revision,dirty:false}. A successful execute_batch clears the redo stack (fresh edits invalidate redo).
